_doc: WO-432 / owner 2026-06-28 — the DESIGNED, data-driven per-tier upgrade table every placed Tower applies on top of its authored TowerData level stats. MIMICS Warcraft 3 incremental research: each level/tier grants more damage (mult + flat add), more range (flat add), and a faster fire rate (cooldown multiplier, lower = faster). Read by the thin interpreter DeNelle.Village.Tower.TowerPerkTable; applied in Tower.CurrentDamage/CurrentRange + TowerCombat fire cadence. tier 1..3 = the Level 1/2/3 placed-tower upgrades; tier 4 = the max-level Empowerment capstone. Effective damage = baseDamage*damageMult + damageAdd (then * village-wide ModifierService.TowerDamageMult). Effective range = baseRange + rangeAdd (then * TowerRangeMult). Effective cooldown = baseCooldown * fireRateMult. Numbers are intentionally modest so per-tier compounding stays sane (~+15-25% dmg/tier). signatureAbility names the capstone signature flair (T3+); the ability behavior itself is owned by the empowerment/SpecialAbility lanes — this table only carries the stat deltas + the id. Resources copy at Assets/Resources/Data/Canonical/tower-perks.json wins at load.
